record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. An October 2025 report says Parliament approved creation of a National AI Organisation for coordination and development under presidential supervision.

check.language_note: The recorded fa query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: IR-extra-search = searches 1, 2 (fa, fa); IR-search = searches 3, 4 (en, fa). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Persian; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.

related_bodies.role: It is an AI strategy and development body under the President, approved by parliament in October 2025.

record.notes: Cited foreign sources for the governance context: TV BRICS (citing Mehr News Agency). Retrieved accounts discuss the National AI Organisation and competing reorganisation proposals. The legal text retrieved from nezamat.ir is a private reproduction; Tasnim's accounts are media reports. A primary national designation source was not retrieved. Searches covered indexed public English and Persian sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
